intro.h2: A Mequon remodeler that starts by asking how you live
paragraphs: Wade Design & Construction handles kitchen and bath remodeling in Mequon and across the North Shore from its office on West Mequon Road. Every project begins with a conversation about your routines: what is not working, where storage runs short, how light moves through the room. The plan grows from those answers, not from a trend board.

Designers and project managers work on one team, so you never pass messages between separate companies. The same group handles whole-home remodels, additions, basements and one-off ideas like wine rooms and screened porches. Clients on Google describe the work as exceptional and say the team really listened during planning.

services.h2: Remodeling services from the Wade design-build team

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: Layouts that cut wasted steps and ease traffic, custom cabinetry built around how you cook, layered lighting and integrated storage. The team looks closely at cabinet depth and workflow so the finished kitchen works for hosting, homework and quiet mornings alike.

image.alt: Mohawk Road kitchen remodel with walnut island seating, white upper cabinets, open wood shelves and a professional range

items.name: Bathroom Remodeling
items.blurb: Primary baths, powder rooms and dated hall baths with custom vanities, spa-style showers with set niches, heated floors and quiet ventilation. Zero-threshold entries and universal design details are part of the menu for families planning to stay in their homes.

image.alt: Holly Road bathroom remodel with green glazed wall tile, freestanding tub, brass floor-mounted tub filler and hexagon floor tile

items.name: Whole-Home Remodeling
items.blurb: A chance to start fresh without moving. Wade rethinks layout and flow, updates systems and picks finishes that hold up to daily life, whether that means opening walls, moving key rooms or tying a dated first floor together.

image.alt: Americana whole-home remodel with open dining room, cluster pendant lighting and a fieldstone fireplace in the family room

items.name: Basement Remodeling
items.blurb: Media rooms, guest suites with full baths, wet bars and home gyms. Moisture control, insulation, soundproofing and airflow are planned first, so the finished lower level feels warm and dry instead of dark and cold.

image.alt: Finished basement on Riveredge Court with leather sectional, blue paneled wall, built-in shelving and patterned carpet

items.name: Specialty Projects and Additions
items.blurb: The ideas that do not fit a category: wine rooms with custom racking and climate control, screened porches with true indoor-outdoor flow, front porch additions, built-in nooks and room additions over garages. Structural and technical challenges are welcome here.

image.alt: Custom wine cellar with arched ceiling, wood wine racking, lighted display cabinets and glass-paned doors

why_choose_us.h2: What sets Wade apart on the North Shore

items.title: Award-winning bath design
items.text: Wade earned a 2025 Chrysalis Award in the $50,000 to $75,000 bath remodel class for a 1925 guest bath with an arched shower entry and traditional fixtures.

items.title: Years of Houzz service honors
items.text: Best of Houzz for Service in 2013 through 2016, 2018 and 2020 through 2025, plus Best of Houzz for Design in five separate years.

items.title: One team, start to finish
items.text: Designers and project managers stay in sync from the first meeting to final trim, so you have one point of contact instead of a string of separate contractors.

items.title: Schedules clients can plan around
items.text: One client wrote that their first-floor remodel was quoted at about six weeks and finished on time, with daily cleanup and a heads-up whenever crews planned to arrive before 8 a.m.

about.h2: Meet Michael Wade and the team behind the work
about.text: Michael Wade is President of Wade Design & Construction, a full-service design-build firm based in Mequon. Clients often mention Mike by name: one reviewer said he had great ideas for keeping the charm of a 1950s bathroom, and another credits him with designing both her kitchen and primary bath. He works alongside a close-knit group of designers, project managers and trusted local craftspeople. The firm stays rooted in town, too, sponsoring LionFest, the Fox Point Farmers' Market and the Mequon Thiensville Turkey Trot. It belongs to NKBA, the Metro Builders Association and the Mequon-Thiensville Chamber.

image.alt: Michael Wade, President of Wade Design & Construction in Mequon, WI

process.h2: Six steps on their site, five stages for you

steps.title: Getting to know each other
steps.text: A first meeting about how your household moves through the space, what frustrates you and what you picture for the finished room.

steps.title: Designing together
steps.text: The design team shapes a plan around your goals and style, walking through options with you before anything is final.

steps.title: Agreements and selections
steps.text: Once agreements are signed, the team guides you through tile, cabinetry, fixtures and finishes so choices are ready before crews need them.

steps.title: Building your project
steps.text: Project managers coordinate the crew and trusted local trades, keep you updated and protect the parts of your home still in use.

steps.title: Peace of mind and warranty
steps.text: The process closes with a warranty handoff, and the team stays available to support you and your home after the dust settles.

service_area.h2: Serving Mequon and the Milwaukee North Shore
service_area.text: Wade's office sits on West Mequon Road, and most projects land within a short drive of it. The team remodels kitchens, baths and whole homes in Mequon, Thiensville and Cedarburg in Ozaukee County, and in Bayside, Fox Point, River Hills, Whitefish Bay and Milwaukee to the south. Projects elsewhere in Southeast Wisconsin are welcome too, so call to ask about your street.

faq.h2: Questions North Shore homeowners ask Wade

items.q: Do you design and build, or do I need a separate designer?
items.a: Both happen under one roof. Wade is a full-service design-build firm, so the designers who draw your plan work beside the project managers who build it. You avoid juggling multiple contractors, and details you care about carry through from the first sketch to the final trim.

items.q: Can you update an older home without losing its character?
items.a: Yes. Wade's 2025 Chrysalis Award came from a 1925 guest bath that kept traditional fixtures and added an arched shower entry. Another client wrote that Mike had great ideas for keeping some of the charm of her 1950s bathroom while making it work today.

items.q: How long does a remodel take?
items.a: It depends on scope, and the team sets the schedule during planning. As one example, a client wrote that their first-floor remodel was quoted at about six weeks and was finished in about six weeks. Having your own selections ready on time helps the schedule hold.

Yes. The final step of Wade's six-step process is called Peace of mind and warranty, and the team says it stays available to support you after the project wraps up. Ask during your consultation for the written warranty terms that apply to your project.

Call (262) 512-1799 or fill in the short contact form with your location and a description of the project. The first meeting is a conversation about how you live and what you want from the space, so bring photos, wish lists and frustrations.

final_cta.h2: Tell Mike's team what is not working at home
final_cta.text: Share your kitchen or bath plans and the Wade team will set up a design conversation in Mequon or at your house.
